PageSection.title: PageSection
PageSection.description: Represents a configurable section of the website content, such as mission, introduction, or generic content blocks, managed via a CMS.

id.description: Unique identifier for the PageSection entity.

title.description: The display title of the content section.

slug.description: A unique, URL-friendly identifier for the section, used to map it to a specific UI component (e.g., 'lab-mission', 'introduction').

content.description: The main text content for the section, potentially including HTML or markdown.

quote.description: An optional notable quote associated with the section.

quoteAuthor.description: The author of the optional quote.

imageUrl.description: URL to an optional image associated with the section, potentially for parallax backgrounds.

order.description: A numeric value indicating the display order of the section on the page.

NewsItem.title: NewsItem
NewsItem.description: Represents a news article, event, or announcement to be displayed on the lab's website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the NewsItem entity.

title.description: The headline or title of the news item.

date.description: The date when the news item was published or the event is scheduled.

content.description: The full body content or description of the news item.

type.description: The category of the news item (e.g., 'news', 'event', 'announcement').

imageUrl.description: URL to an optional image accompanying the news item.

externalLink.description: An optional external link for more details about the news item or event.

author.description: The author of the news item.

location.description: The location associated with the news item.

imageId.description: ID for a placeholder image from placeholder-images.json.

HistoryMilestone.title: HistoryMilestone
HistoryMilestone.description: Represents a significant event or achievement in the lab's history, displayed as part of a timeline.

id.description: Unique identifier for the HistoryMilestone entity.

year.description: The year in which the milestone occurred.

title.description: A brief title describing the milestone.

description.description: A detailed description of the historical milestone.

imageUrl.description: URL to an optional image related to the milestone.

imageId.description: ID for a placeholder image from placeholder-images.json.

Facility.title: Facility
Facility.description: Represents a research facility or equipment available at the lab.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Facility entity.

name.description: The name of the facility or equipment (e.g., 'Micro-chemistry Lab (1.11G)').

description.description: A detailed description of the facility, its capabilities, and available equipment.

imageUrl.description: URL to an optional image of the facility.

location.description: The physical location of the facility within the lab or building.

TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Represents a current or past member of the lab, including their profile and photo.

id.description: Unique identifier for the TeamMember entity.

firstName.description: The first name of the team member.

lastName.description: The last name of the team member.

order.description: A number used for manual sorting of team members. Lower numbers appear first.

role.description: The role or position of the team member (e.g., 'Principal Investigator', 'Research Assistant').

bio.description: A short biography of the team member.

photoUrl.description: URL to the team member's photo.

isActive.description: Indicates whether the team member is currently active in the lab.

startDate.description: The date when the team member joined the lab.

endDate.description: The date when the team member left the lab, if applicable.

externalLink.description: An optional external link for the team member (e.g., personal website, LinkedIn profile).

ResearchHighlight.title: ResearchHighlight
ResearchHighlight.description: Represents a key research highlight, discovery, or publication to be featured on the website.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ResearchHighlight entity.

title.description: The title of the research highlight.

description.description: A brief summary of the highlight.

category.description: A category for the highlight (e.g., 'Publication Highlight', 'Project Highlight').

link.description: An external link for more details.

imageId.description: ID for a placeholder image from placeholder-images.json.

imageUrl.description: URL for an image for the highlight.

order.description: A numeric value indicating the display order.

Project.title: Project
Project.description: Represents a research project conducted by the lab, including its description and highlights.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Project entity.

title.description: The title of the research project.

description.description: A brief description or summary of the project.

startDate.description: The start date of the project.

endDate.description: The estimated or actual end date of the project.

status.description: The current status of the project (e.g., 'Ongoing', 'Completed', 'Archived').

imageUrl.description: URL to a supporting visual or image for the project.

externalLink.description: An external link for more detailed information about the project.

fundingSource.description: The source of funding for the project.

fundingSourceUrl.description: A URL to the funding source's website.

budget.description: The total budget for the project.

researchArea.description: Keywords or a general category describing the research area of the project.

teamMemberIds.description: References to TeamMember entities involved in this project. (Relationship: Project N:N TeamMember)

Publication.title: Publication
Publication.description: Represents a scientific publication authored by lab members.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Publication entity.

title.description: The full title of the publication.

authors.description: An array of strings, each representing an author of the publication.

year.description: The year the publication was published.

journal.description: The name of the journal or conference where the publication was featured.

journalLink.description: A URL linking to the journal's homepage.

abstract.description: The abstract or summary of the publication.

doi.description: The Digital Object Identifier (DOI) for the publication.

externalLink.description: A URL linking to the full text or publisher's page of the publication.

impactFactor.description: The impact factor of the journal at the time of publication.

keywords.description: An array of keywords associated with the publication.

teamMemberIds.description: References to TeamMember entities from the lab who authored this publication. (Relationship: Publication N:N TeamMember)

LabStatistic.title: LabStatistic
LabStatistic.description: Stores key statistics and impact metrics for the lab.

id.description: Unique identifier for the LabStatistic entity (e.g., 'lab-stats').

totalProjects.description: The total number of research projects conducted.

totalPublications.description: The total number of publications produced by the lab.

impactFactor.description: The cumulative impact factor of the lab's publications.

hirschIndex.description: The Hirsch index (h-index) for the lab's research output.

totalFunding.description: The total research funding secured by the lab, in a common currency unit (e.g., USD).

lastUpdated.description: The date and time when these statistics were last updated.

Opportunity.title: Opportunity
Opportunity.description: Represents an open position, diploma thesis topic, or other opportunity to join or collaborate with the lab.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Opportunity entity.

title.description: The title of the opportunity (e.g., 'Postdoc Position', 'Master Thesis Topic').

description.description: A detailed description of the opportunity, including requirements and application instructions.

type.description: The type of opportunity (e.g., 'Open Position', 'Diploma Thesis', 'Internship').

applicationDeadline.description: The deadline for applications, if applicable.

contactEmail.description: An email address for inquiries about the opportunity.

externalLink.description: An optional external link to an application portal or more information.

postedDate.description: The date when the opportunity was first posted.

Dedicated collection for Database Access Control (DBAC) storing users with administrator roles. Existence of a document at this path for a given 'userId' grants administrative privileges across all CMS collections. This supports Authorization Independence and QAPs by making admin checks direct and explicit.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user with administrative privileges.

firestore.reasoning:
The addition of `PageSection` entities for CMS management follows the established pattern for public-facing, administrator-managed content. The primary recommendation is to place all `PageSection` documents in a top-level collection named `/page_sections`. This structure adheres to the core design principles by ensuring robust security rules, scalability, and debuggability.

**Authorization Independence:** Documents within `/page_sections` are designed to be entirely self-contained for authorization purposes. Each `PageSection` document contains all necessary data (`slug`, `order`, `content`, etc.) without requiring `get()` calls to parent documents to determine access rights. Since these are public-facing content, the authorization model is simple: `read` access for all users, and `write` access restricted to authenticated administrators. This eliminates any hierarchical dependencies, fulfilling the 'Authorization Independence' mandate and simplifying security rule evaluation.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):** By segregating all `PageSection` documents into a single collection with a homogeneous security posture (publicly readable), `list` operations become inherently secure and efficient. Security rules can simply allow read access to `/page_sections/{pageSectionId}` for `request.auth != null` (or even `true` for truly public anonymous read) and `write` access for authenticated administrators. This prevents the need for complex `where` clauses in rules to filter data, thereby supporting Query-as-Permission (QAP) principles. The structure avoids mixing data with different access requirements, allowing for clear and predictable rule sets. Administrator roles would be managed via a separate, dedicated `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection, enabling efficient DBAC (Database Access Control) without custom claims.
